questions.question: Clarify the relationship between the modern Horner scheme and the 1819 paper. A. Thomas Fuller’s *Horner versus Holdred* examines Holdred’s earlier publication and De Morgan’s role in establishing the name; MacTutor distinguishes Horner’s 1819 and 1830 papers.

localizations.source: Clarify the relationship between the modern Horner scheme and the 1819 paper. A. Thomas Fuller’s *Horner versus Holdred* examines Holdred’s earlier publication and De Morgan’s role in establishing the name; MacTutor distinguishes Horner’s 1819 and 1830 papers.
localizations.ru: Уточнить связь современной «схемы Горнера» со статьёй 1819 года. Исследование А. Томаса Фуллера *Horner versus Holdred* разбирает более раннюю публикацию Холдреда и роль Де Моргана в закреплении имени; MacTutor отдельно различает статьи Горнера 1819 и 1830 годов.

questions.resolution: The wording was corrected from A. Thomas Fuller’s study: Horner’s 1819 paper concerned continuous approximation, Holdred published a similar method earlier, and De Morgan later helped establish Horner’s name.
